# Create spatial CD8 phenotypes

```{r}
sce <- aggregateNeighbors(sce, colPairName = "neighborhood", aggregate_by = "metadata", count_by = "celltype_combined_broad", proportions = FALSE, name = "count_neighbors")
```

#  ## Spatial CD8 Pattern ##
based on Ruben Casanova and Hammerl et al., 2022

### Definition
```{r}
## Step 1: CD8 T cell type scoring 
cur_dat <- sce$count_neighbors %>% as.data.frame
rownames(cur_dat) <- sce$cell_id
cur_dat$PID <- sce$PID

cur_dat$celltype_combined_broad <- sce$celltype_combined_broad

# Define CD8+ T cells as infiltrating, bystanding, ignored
cur_dat <- cur_dat %>% filter(celltype_combined_broad == "CD8") %>%
  mutate(CD8Tcell_type = ifelse(tumor >= 3, "infiltrating", 
                                ifelse(tumor < 3 & tumor > 0, "bystanding", "ignored")))

sce$CD8Tcell_type <- cur_dat$CD8Tcell_type[match(sce$cell_id, rownames(cur_dat))]

# Define a combined score for CD8+ and CD4+ T cells as infiltrating, bystanding, ignored
cur_dat <- cur_dat %>% filter(celltype_combined_broad == "CD4") %>%
  mutate(CD4Tcell_type = ifelse(tumor >= 3, "infiltrating", 
                                ifelse(tumor < 3 & tumor > 0, "bystanding", "ignored")))

sce$CD4Tcell_type <- cur_dat$CD4Tcell_type[match(sce$cell_id, rownames(cur_dat))]

sce$Tcell_type <- ifelse(sce$celltype_combined_broad == "CD8", sce$CD8Tcell_type,
                         ifelse(sce$celltype_combined_broad == "CD4", sce$CD4Tcell_type, NA))
```

### Differential Expression Analysis

Function
```{r}
library(EnhancedVolcano)

# Function
DE_analysis <- function(sce, x, group, MOC) {
  
  category_name <- paste0(x, "_other")
  
  sce[[category_name]] <- ifelse(sce[[group]] == x, x, "other")
  
  # 1. Aggregate expression per PID and category 
  mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce,
                                   ids = DataFrame(sce$PID, sce[[category_name]]),
                                   statistics = "mean",
                                   use.assay.type = "exprs")
  
  
  # 2. Calculate log2FC 
  ## Aggregate per category 
  mean_sce_1 <- aggregateAcrossCells(mean_sce,
                       ids = mean_sce$sce..category_name.., 
                       statistics = "mean",
                       use.assay.type = "exprs")
  
  
  logFC <- log2(assay(mean_sce_1, "exprs")[,mean_sce_1$sce..category_name.. == x]/
                assay(mean_sce_1, "exprs")[,mean_sce_1$sce..category_name.. == "other"])
  

  # 3. Calculate p-value (based on t-test)
  exprs <- as.data.frame(t(assay(mean_sce)))
  
  exprs[[category_name]] <- mean_sce[[category_name]]
  
  p_value <- c()
  for (i in 1:(length(colnames(exprs))-1)) {
    t <- t.test(exprs[exprs[[category_name]] == x,i], exprs[exprs[[category_name]] == "other",i])
    p_value[i] <- t$p.value
  }
  ## Adjust p.value 
  p_value_adj <- p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  names(p_value_adj) <- colnames(exprs)[1:(length(colnames(exprs))-1)]
  
  # 4. Plot VolcanoPlot 
  data <- as.data.frame(cbind(logFC, p_value_adj))
  data <- data[which(rownames(data) %in% MOC),] # choose markers
  
  keyvals <- ifelse(
     data$logFC < -0.2, "#E41A1C",
        ifelse(data$logFC > 0.2, "#377EB8",
          'black'))
    keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#E41A1C"] <- 'High other'
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'black'] <- 'Not Sig'
    names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#377EB8"] <- paste("High", x)
    
  return(EnhancedVolcano(data,
      lab = rownames(data),
      x = 'logFC',
      y = 'p_value_adj',
      title = '',
      boxedLabels = TRUE,
      pCutoff = 0.05,
      FCcutoff = 0.2,
      drawConnectors = TRUE,
      pointSize = 8.0,
      labSize = 8.0, 
      colCustom = keyvals))
}
```

Function calls
```{r}
# subset to CD8 T cells
cur_sce <- sce[, !is.na(sce$immune_metacluster) & sce$immune_metacluster == "CD8_T_cell"]

# define markers
type_markers <- rownames(cur_sce)[rowData(cur_sce)$Tcell_cluster_channel]

## infiltrating
DE_analysis(cur_sce, "infiltrating", "CD8Tcell_type", type_markers)

## bystanding
DE_analysis(cur_sce, "bystanding", "CD8Tcell_type", type_markers)

## ignoring
DE_analysis(cur_sce, "ignoring", "CD8Tcell_type", type_markers)
```

```{r}
Heatmap(contingency_table %>% as.matrix(), name = "n cells", col = col)

col = colorRamp2(c(0, max(for_plot)), c("#443A83FF", "#FDE725FF"))
```

##### CD8 T cell score
```{r}
cur_sce <- sce[, !is.na(sce$immune_metacluster) & sce$immune_metacluster == "CD8_T_cell"]

cur_sce$infiltrating <- ifelse(cur_sce$CD8Tcell_type == "infiltrating", 1, 0)
cur_sce$bystanding <- ifelse(cur_sce$CD8Tcell_type == "bystanding", 1, 0)
cur_sce$ignored <- ifelse(cur_sce$CD8Tcell_type == "ignored", 1, 0)

cur_sce$Memory_like_CD8 <- ifelse(cur_sce$celltype_combined == "Memory-like_CD8", 1, 0)
cur_sce$Exhausted_like_CD8 <- ifelse(cur_sce$celltype_combined == "Exhausted-like_CD8", 1, 0)
cur_sce$Cytotoxic_like_CD8 <- ifelse(cur_sce$celltype_combined == "Cytotoxic-like_CD8", 1, 0)
cur_sce$CXCL13_like_CD8 <- ifelse(cur_sce$celltype_combined == "CXCL13-like_CD8", 1, 0)
cur_sce$Naive_like_CD8 <- ifelse(cur_sce$celltype_combined == "Naive-like_CD8", 1, 0)
cur_sce$Exhausted_cytotoxic_like_CD8 <- ifelse(cur_sce$celltype_combined == "Exhausted_cytotoxic-like_CD8", 1, 0)
# cur_sce$Unknown_Other_CD8 <- ifelse(cur_sce$celltype_combined == "Unknown/Other_CD8", 1, 0)
# cur_sce$Activated_like_CD8 <- ifelse(cur_sce$celltype_combined == "Activated-like_CD8", 1, 0)
# cur_sce$Inhibitory_like_CD8 <- ifelse(cur_sce$celltype_combined == "Inhibitory-like_CD8", 1, 0)
```

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- colData(cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(Memory_like_CD8, Exhausted_like_CD8, Cytotoxic_like_CD8, CXCL13_like_CD8, Naive_like_CD8, Exhausted_cytotoxic_like_CD8,
                                                     # Unknown_Other_CD8, Activated_like_CD8, Inhibitory_like_CD8
                                                                   )

# Binary mutation matrix
cur_mut <- colData(cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(infiltrating, bystanding, ignored) %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("Memory_like_CD8", "Exhausted_like_CD8", "Cytotoxic_like_CD8", "CXCL13_like_CD8", "Naive_like_CD8", "Exhausted_cytotoxic_like_CD8",
                             # "Unknown_Other_CD8", "Activated_like_CD8", "Inhibitory_like_CD8"
                             ), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- rownames(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",])
  PID_low <- rownames(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",])
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("spatial_phenotype", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "celltype", "p_out")
```

```{r}
library(ggnewscale)

# FDR at 0.05
fisher_full$result <- ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.05, "UP",
                                    ifelse(fisher_full$odds_ratio < 1 & fisher_full$p_adj < 0.05, "DOWN","NOTSIG"))

## hierarchical clustering on odds_ratio
cur_df <- fisher_full %>% dplyr::select(spatial_phenotype, celltype, odds_ratio) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = odds_ratio, names_from = spatial_phenotype)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$celltype <- factor(fisher_full$celltype, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$celltype)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order
fisher_full$spatial_phenotype <- factor(fisher_full$spatial_phenotype, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


CD8Pheno_fisher <- ggplot(fisher_full, aes(x=celltype, y = spatial_phenotype,col = odds_ratio, size = -log10(p_adj)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8", midpoint = 1)+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = fisher_full,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(p_adj), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

#### compare between spatial CD8 phenotypes

```{r}
dist_vec <- c("DistToExCD8", "DistToEx_ctxCD8", "DistToExCD4", "DistToAct", "DistToMem", "DistToNaiveCD8", "DistToNaiveCD4", "DistToTh1", "DistToTreg", "DistToCXCL13CD4", "DistToCXCL13CD8", "DistToMacro")

plot_list <- list()
plot_counter <- 1

for (col_name in dist_vec) {
  # Prepare the data
  df <- colData(sce) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>%
    select(!!sym(col_name), celltype_combined, CD8Tcell_type) %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(col_name)) & !is.na(CD8Tcell_type))
  
  kruskal_results <- df %>% group_by(celltype_combined) %>%
    summarize(p.value = kruskal.test(as.formula(paste0(col_name, " ~ CD8Tcell_type")))$p.value)%>%
    mutate(adj_p_value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = CD8Tcell_type, y = !!sym(col_name), fill = celltype_combined)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    facet_wrap(~celltype_combined, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(y = col_name, 
         title = col_name) +
    geom_text(data = kruskal_results, aes(x = 1.5, y = max(df[[col_name]], na.rm = TRUE), 
                                          label = paste0("Adj p = ", signif(adj_p_value, 3))),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0)
  
  # Save the plot in the list
  plot_list[[plot_counter]] <- p
  plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
}

# Display the plots
plot_list
```

### Correlation Analysis

```{r}
# Proportion of infiltrating cells
cur_df <- colData(sce) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(immune_metacluster == "CD8_T_cell") %>%
  group_by(sample_id, CD8Tcell_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop')

proportion_inf <- cur_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CD8Tcell_type, values_from = n, values_fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion_infiltrating = infiltrating / (ignored + bystanding),
    total_cells = infiltrating + ignored + bystanding
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, proportion_infiltrating, total_cells)

# Proportion of Exhausted cells
cur_df <- colData(sce) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(immune_metacluster != "tumor") %>%
  group_by(sample_id, celltype_combined) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = 'drop')

proportion_ex <- cur_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = celltype_combined, values_from = n, values_fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  mutate(
    total_exhausted = `Exhausted-like_CD4` + `Exhausted-like_CD8` + `Exhausted_cytotoxic-like_CD8`,
    total_other = rowSums(dplyr::select(., -sample_id, -`Exhausted-like_CD4`, -`Exhausted-like_CD8`, -`Exhausted_cytotoxic-like_CD8`)),
    proportion_exhausted = total_exhausted / (total_other + total_exhausted)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_id, proportion_exhausted, total_other)

# merge
merged_df <- left_join(proportion_inf, proportion_ex, by = "sample_id")

merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  filter(
         # !is.na(proportion_exhausted) | 
         # !is.na(proportion_infiltrating) | 
         # !is.nan(proportion_exhausted) | 
         # !is.nan(proportion_infiltrating) | 
         # !is.infinite(proportion_exhausted)|
         !is.infinite(proportion_infiltrating))

cor_test <- cor.test(merged_df$proportion_exhausted, merged_df$proportion_infiltrating, method = "spearman")

# Create a scatter plot with the correlation information
ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = proportion_exhausted, y = proportion_infiltrating)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") + # Add a trendline
  labs(
    # title = paste("Correlation between Proportion of Exhausted and Infiltrating Cells"),
    subtitle = paste("Spearman r =", round(cor_test$estimate, 2), ", p-value =", signif(cor_test$p.value, 3)),
    x = "Proportion Exhausted Cells",
    y = "Proportion Infiltrating Cells"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  ggtitle(paste0("p value (corr.test) = ", cor.test(merged_df$proportion_infiltrating, merged_df$proportion_exhausted, method = "spearman")$p.value))
```



# ## Spatial CD8 Group ##

## Constructing Group -per sample-

### Parameter sweep

1. first assignment done per sample

- based on parameters: ratio_inf_ex, infiltrating, number_inf_ex_threshold, ignored

2. patients with multiple assignments are assigned to a category according to this scheme

- patients having inflamed & excluded images =(assigned to)=> inflamed or excluded
- patients having inflamed & cold images =(assigned to)=> inflamed or cold
- patients having excluded & cold images =(assigned to)=> excluded or cold
- patients having images from all =(assigned to)=> inflamed or excluded


```{r}
cur_dat <- sce$count_neighbors %>% as.data.frame
rownames(cur_dat) <- sce$cell_id
cur_dat$sample_id <- sce$sample_id
cur_dat$celltype_combined_broad <- sce$celltype_combined_broad

# Define CD8+ T cells as infiltrating, bystanding, ignored
cur_dat <- cur_dat %>% filter(celltype_combined_broad == "CD8") %>% 
  mutate(CD8Tcell_type = ifelse(tumor >= 3, "infiltrating", 
                                ifelse(tumor < 3 & tumor > 0, "bystanding", "ignored")))

# try per sample_id
out <- cur_dat %>% group_by(sample_id, CD8Tcell_type) %>% dplyr::count() %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = sample_id, values_from = n, names_from = CD8Tcell_type, values_fill = list(n = 0)) %>% # add values_fill 
  mutate(ratio_inf_ex = ifelse(infiltrating == 0, 0, bystanding / infiltrating), number_inf_ex = bystanding + infiltrating) %>% # ratio = 0 if inf == 0
  mutate(spatial_grouptype = ifelse(ratio_inf_ex >= 7 | infiltrating <= 5, "excluded", "inflamed")) %>% 
  mutate(spatial_grouptype = ifelse((number_inf_ex <= 5 & ignored < 20) | is.na(number_inf_ex), "cold", spatial_grouptype))


out$PID <- sce$PID[match(out$sample_id, sce$sample_id)]
cur_df <- out %>% 
  dplyr::select(PID, spatial_grouptype, ratio_inf_ex) %>%
  group_by(PID, spatial_grouptype) %>%
  summarize(ratio_inf_ex = mean(ratio_inf_ex, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')


cur_df <- cur_df%>% pivot_wider(id_cols = PID, names_from = spatial_grouptype, values_from = ratio_inf_ex, values_fill = list(ratio_inf_ex = 0))

pid_inflamed_excluded <- cur_df %>% filter(cold == 0 & excluded != 0 & inflamed != 0) %>% pull(PID)
pid_excluded_cold <- cur_df %>% filter(inflamed == 0 & cold != 0 & excluded != 0) %>% pull(PID)
pid_inflamed_cold <- cur_df %>% filter(excluded == 0 & cold != 0 & inflamed != 0) %>% pull(PID)
pid_all <- cur_df %>% filter(excluded != 0 & cold != 0 & inflamed != 0) %>% pull(PID)

keep_track <- out %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, PID, spatial_grouptype)
colnames(keep_track) <- c("sample_id", "PID", "first_annotation_ratio")

out$spatial_grouptype <- ifelse(
  out$PID %in% pid_inflamed_excluded, "inflamed", 
  ifelse(out$PID %in% pid_inflamed_cold, "inflamed",
  ifelse(out$PID %in% pid_all, "excluded",
  ifelse(out$PID %in% pid_excluded_cold, "cold", out$spatial_grouptype)))
      )

keep_track$second_annotation <- ifelse(keep_track$PID %in% c(pid_inflamed_excluded, pid_excluded_cold, pid_inflamed_cold, pid_all),
                                       out$spatial_grouptype[match(keep_track$PID, out$PID)], 
                                       FALSE) # FALSE if the PID has samples uniquely belonging to one phenotype

# Add to sce
sce$spatial_group <- out$spatial_grouptype[match(sce$sample_id, out$sample_id)]

sce[,is.na(sce$spatial_group)]$spatial_group <- "cold"

spatial_group_col <- setNames(c("navy", "firebrick","darkolivegreen3"), unique(sce$spatial_group)) 
metadata(sce)$colors$spatial_group <- spatial_group_col

sce$spatial_group_merg <- ifelse(sce$spatial_group == "inflamed", "inflamed", "cold_excluded")
  
spatial_group_merg_col <- setNames(c("darkolivegreen3", "firebrick"), unique(sce$spatial_group_merg)) 
metadata(sce)$colors$spatial_group_merg <- spatial_group_merg_col
```

## Differential Abundance Analysis
### clinical information
```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){
abundances <- table(sce$spatial_group, sce$PID)

abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

if(x %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
library(ggnewscale)

DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined", "PDL1_score"))

DA_out$result <- ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "UP",
                             ifelse(DA_out$logFC > 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "UP_trend", 
                                    ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$FDR < 0.1, "DOWN", 
                                           ifelse(DA_out$logFC < 0 & DA_out$PValue < 0.05, "DOWN_trend","NOTSIG"))))


p <- ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y=category, col=logFC, size=-log10(FDR))) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_color_gradient2(high="#E41A1C", mid="white", low="#377EB8") +
  scale_size(range=c(2,10)) +
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data=DA_out, shape=1, aes(size=-log10(FDR), col=result), stroke=1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("UP"="#9f1214", "UP_trend"="#e73032", "NOTSIG"="snow2", "DOWN_trend"="#428bc7", "DOWN"="#25567d"), name="Direction") +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))
```

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

sce_immune$excluded <- ifelse(sce_immune$spatial_group == "excluded", 1, 0)
sce_immune$inflamed <- ifelse(sce_immune$spatial_group == "inflamed", 1, 0)
sce_immune$cold <- ifelse(sce_immune$spatial_group == "cold", 1, 0)


DA <- lapply(c("excluded", "inflamed", "cold"), function(x){

abundances <- table(sce_immune$immune_metacluster, sce_immune$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_immune)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_immune$PID),]

meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```


```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
library(ggnewscale)

# FDR at 0.05
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("excluded", "inflamed", "cold"))

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_out %>% dplyr::select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order

DA_out$cluster <- factor(DA_out$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))

DA_immune <- ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
sce_immune$inflamed <- ifelse(sce_immune$spatial_group == "inflamed", 1, 0)
sce_immune$cold <- ifelse(sce_immune$spatial_group == "cold", 1, 0)

DA <- lapply(c("excluded", "inflamed", "cold"), function(x){

abundances <- table(sce_immune$celltype_combined, sce_immune$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce_immune)[match(colnames(abundances), sce_immune$PID),]

meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r}
# FDR at 0.05
DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("excluded", "inflamed", "cold"))

# dplyr::select T cells only 
# DA_plot <- DA_out[str_detect(DA_out$cluster, "CD4|CD8"),]
# DA_plot <- DA_out[str_detect(DA_out$cluster, "CD4"),]
DA_plot <- DA_out[str_detect(DA_out$cluster, "CD8"),]
DA_plot <- DA_plot[complete.cases(DA_plot),]

## hierarchical clustering on logFC
cur_df <- DA_plot %>% dplyr::select(cluster, category, logFC) %>% pivot_wider(values_from = logFC, names_from = cluster)

# rows 
dd <- dist(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)], method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order
DA_plot$category <- factor(DA_plot$category, levels = cur_df[row_sorted,]$category)

# columns 
dd <- dist(t(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)]), method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
column_sorted <- hc$order


DA_plot$cluster <- factor(DA_plot$cluster, levels = colnames(cur_df[2:ncol(cur_df)][,column_sorted]))


DA_CD8 <- ggplot(DA_plot, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_plot,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
```

## Fisher based testing
### Clinical Categories
```{r}
cur_sce <- sce

cur_sce$excluded <- ifelse(sce$spatial_group == "excluded", 1, 0)
cur_sce$cold <- ifelse(sce$spatial_group == "cold", 1, 0)
cur_sce$inflamed <- ifelse(sce$spatial_group == "inflamed", 1, 0)
```

```{r}
# Patient group info 
cur_groups <- colData(cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID, ISUP_combined, pT_combined, necrose, PDL1_score) %>% unique()

# Binary mutation matrix
cur_mut <- colData(cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID, excluded, cold, inflamed) %>% unique() %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","PDL1_score","necrose"), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  if(i %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
    PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",]$PID)
    PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",]$PID)
  }else{
    PID_high <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "3/4",]$PID)
    PID_low <- unique(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1/2",]$PID)
  }  
  
  PID_high <- PID_high[!is.na(PID_high)]
  PID_low <- PID_low[!is.na(PID_low)]
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("gene", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "category", "p_out")
```

```{r}
                                                                   # Unknown_Other_CD8, Activated_like_CD8, Inhibitory_like_CD8
                                                                   )

# Binary mutation matrix
cur_mut <- colData(cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(infiltrating, bystanding, ignored) %>% t()

# Function to perform Fisher exact test for each gene
perform_fisher_test <- function(gene_row, group1_cols, group2_cols) {
    contingency_table <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2)
    contingency_table[1, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[1, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 1)
    contingency_table[2, 1] <- sum(gene_row[group1_cols] == 0)
    contingency_table[2, 2] <- sum(gene_row[group2_cols] == 0)
    test_result <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
    return(c(odds_ratio = test_result$estimate, p_value = test_result$p.value))
  }
  
fisher_full <- foreach(i = c("Memory_like_CD8", "Exhausted_like_CD8", "Cytotoxic_like_CD8", "CXCL13_like_CD8", "Naive_like_CD8", "Exhausted_cytotoxic_like_CD8",
                             # "Unknown_Other_CD8", "Activated_like_CD8", "Inhibitory_like_CD8"
                             ), .combine = "rbind")%do%{

  PID_high <- rownames(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "1",])
  PID_low <- rownames(cur_groups[cur_groups[, i] == "0",])
  
  fisher_results <- apply(cur_mut, 1, perform_fisher_test, group1_cols = PID_high, group2_cols = PID_low)
  
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(fisher_results)
  fisher_results <- as.data.frame(t(fisher_results)) %>% rownames_to_column("gene")
  fisher_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(fisher_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  fisher_results$category <- i
  
  return(fisher_results)
  }

isGreater <- fisher_full$odds_ratio > 1
pVal <- log10(fisher_full$p_value)
pVal[isGreater] <- abs(pVal[isGreater])
fisher_full$p_out <- pVal
colnames(fisher_full) <- c("spatial_phenotype", "odds_ratio", "p_value", "p_adj", "celltype", "p_out")
```

### log Rank Test
```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

out_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(PID, OS_months, status_OS, "excluded", "inflamed", "cold") %>% unique() 

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_out <- foreach(x = colnames(out_df %>% dplyr::select(-PID, -status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = out_df)
  p_value <- 1 - pchisq(fit$chisq, length(fit$n) - 1)
  data.frame(group = x, p = p_value, obs_2 = fit$obs[1], exp_2 = fit$exp[1])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_out$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_out$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_out %>% mutate(sign = p < 0.05, direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% arrange(desc(p_out)) %>% filter(p < 0.05)

cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_plot %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = type, names_from = group, values_from = p_out) %>% column_to_rownames("type")

col = colorRamp2(c(min(cur_surv_plot), 0, max(cur_surv_plot)), c("blue", "white", "#D73027"))

Heatmap(cur_surv_plot, col = col, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), name = "log10(p)")
```

```{r}
for (col_name in dist_vec) {
  df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(.data[[col_name]], celltype_combined, spatial_group)
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = spatial_group, y = .data[[col_name]], fill = celltype_combined)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    facet_wrap(~celltype_combined, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(y = col_name, title = col_name)
  
  plot_list[[plot_counter]] <- p
  plot_counter <- plot_counter + 1
}

# Display the plots
plot_list
```

Visualise the difference in distance between Inflamed and excluded
```{r}
# create placeholder matrix for excluded and inflamed
rownames <- sce$celltype_combined %>% unique
colnames <- c("DistToExCD8", "DistToEx_ctxCD8", "DistToExCD4", "DistToAct", "DistToMem", "DistToNaiveCD8", "DistToNaiveCD4", "DistToTh1", "DistToTreg", "DistToCXCL13CD4", "DistToCXCL13CD8", "DistToMacro")
na_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(rownames), ncol = length(colnames))
excluded_df <- data.frame(na_matrix, row.names = rownames)
colnames(excluded_df) <- colnames
inflamed_df <- data.frame(na_matrix, row.names = rownames)
colnames(inflamed_df) <- colnames

# function
add_mean <- function(col_name, phenotype, df){
cur_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(spatial_group == phenotype) %>% select(.data[[col_name]], celltype_combined, spatial_group) %>% group_by(celltype_combined) %>% summarise(mean = mean(.data[[col_name]], na.rm = TRUE))
df[[col_name]] <- cur_df$mean[match(rownames(excluded_df), cur_df$celltype_combined)]
return(df)
}

# calculate excluded df
for (col in colnames) {
  excluded_df <- add_mean(col, "excluded", excluded_df)
}


# calculate inflames df
for (col in colnames) {
  inflamed_df <- add_mean(col, "inflamed", inflamed_df)
}


dist_df <- inflamed_df - excluded_df


Heatmap(as.matrix(dist_df))
```

### Macrophage T cell distances

#### Mean per patient

```{r}
cur_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by(PID, celltype_combined) %>% summarise(mean=mean(DistToMacro, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% filter(str_detect(celltype_combined, "CD4|CD8"))

cur_df$average_graph <- sce$average_graph_cluster_named[match(cur_df$PID, sce$PID)]
cur_df$spatial_group <- sce$spatial_group[match(cur_df$PID, sce$PID)]

# Calculate the y-axis limits based on quantiles
lower_limit <- quantile(cur_df$mean, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
upper_limit <- quantile(cur_df$mean, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)

sub_df <- cur_df %>% filter(spatial_group!= "cold", !celltype_combined %in% c("Unknown/Other_CD4", "Unknown/Other_CD8", "Activated-like_CD8", "Inhibitory-like_CD8"))

# Calculate the y-axis limits based on quantiles
lower_limit <- quantile(sub_df$mean, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
upper_limit <- quantile(sub_df$mean, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)


# Plot
ggplot(data=sub_df, aes(x=spatial_group, y=mean, color=celltype_combined)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~celltype_combined, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$celltype_combined) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(lower_limit, upper_limit))


sub_df <- cur_df %>% filter(average_graph!= "tumor_cold", !celltype_combined %in% c("Unknown/Other_CD4", "Unknown/Other_CD8", "Activated-like_CD8", "Inhibitory-like_CD8"))

# Calculate the y-axis limits based on quantiles
lower_limit <- quantile(sub_df$mean, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
upper_limit <- quantile(sub_df$mean, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)


ggplot(data=sub_df, aes(x=average_graph, y=mean, color=celltype_combined)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~celltype_combined, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$celltype_combined) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(lower_limit, upper_limit))
```
